title: Minipurge:Black
description: Add-on to Minipurge. Adds Bunkers that automatically spawn throughout the game map.
body:
# ⚫ Minipurge: Black | Underground Bunkers Add-on

**Take the fight underground!** Minipurge: Black is an official add-on for the [Minipurge](https://modrinth.com/datapack/minipurge) event framework that automatically generates fortified underground bunkers across your arena at the beginning of each round.

Instead of just fighting in the open or hiding in standard caves, players can now discover and lock down these custom-built structures. Will you use a bunker as a heavily fortified base of operations during the "Peace" phase, or will you wait in the shadows below to ambush unsuspecting scavengers?

![Outside a Bunker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f03968abeac07629e7e5229bdaea3ffc6ce76b2.jpeg)

![Inside a Bunker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8d4f09f3f05959372fa387ada951be37232abc1.jpeg)

---

## ✨ Features

* **🕳️ Automatic Generation:** Bunkers spawn seamlessly and randomly throughout the environment as soon as the event starts.
* **🏰 Strategic Strongholds:** Provides instant, pre-built defensive positions that players can claim, reinforce, and fight over as the world border shrinks.

---

## ⚙️ How to Install
1. Make sure you have the core **[Minipurge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/minipurge)** data pack installed in your world.
2. Drop the `Minipurge:Black` `.zip` file into your world's `datapacks` folder alongside it.
3. Start your event normally! Minipurge will automatically handle the bunker generation.

---
